name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 49, introductory part – Am 106
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 49. Calls on the Union institutions to reduce their administrative expenditure and eliminate non-essential expenditure; calls for the streamlining of administrative structures to avoid duplication and unjustified costs; considers that requests for increases in appropriations or staff should remain exceptional and be based on clearly demonstrated needs; calls, in particular, for a reduction in the administrative expenditure of bodies and institutions whose mandates overlap or whose added value does not justify the current level of spending;
